boards.school_name: SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Syracuse food destinations with publicly posted late hours. Confirm hours and service mode before leaving campus.

cards.entity_name: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill
cards.title: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill
cards.subtitle: 712 E Fayette Street, Syracuse
cards.notes: Use the direct-order page to check the day’s schedule, then place a pickup or delivery order; the posted Thursday–Saturday closing time is 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown deli-and-grill option with published midnight and 2 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: The business lists hours through midnight Monday–Wednesday and through 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 712 E Fayette Street.
cards.source_title: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill — Syracuse
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Wed 7 a.m.–12 a.m.; Thu–Fri 7 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sat 10 a.m.–2 a.m.; closed Sun. Check ordering availability before travel.

cards.title: Over the Cuse Pizza & Wings at CODA
cards.subtitle: 399 S Crouse Avenue, Syracuse
cards.notes: Check the online ordering page before heading out. This separate Crouse Avenue location posts midnight weekday service and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A Crouse Avenue pizza-and-wings counter with late posted ordering hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The ordering page lists Over the Cuse Pizza & Wings at 399 S Crouse Avenue and hours until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Over the Cuse Pizza & Wings — online ordering
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Wed 10 a.m.–12 a.m.; Thu–Sat 10 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sun 12 p.m.–10 p.m. Confirm pickup or delivery availability in the ordering flow.

cards.title: Tazza on Westcott Street
cards.subtitle: 466 Westcott Street, Syracuse
cards.notes: Plan a food-focused stop on Westcott Street and verify the day’s status first; Tazza publishes midnight closing Monday through Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Westcott Street restaurant with a consistently posted midnight window most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Tazza lists its address as 466 Westcott Street and hours until 12 a.m. Monday–Saturday, with Sunday until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Sat 11 a.m.–12 a.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Verify service and ordering before departure.

cards.title: Franco's Pizzeria and Deli delivery window
cards.subtitle: 901 E Genesee Street, Syracuse
cards.notes: Use Franco’s own site to place a delivery or carry-out order. The business posts delivery to the university area until 3 a.m. daily, while counter hours differ.
cards.short_summary: A Genesee Street pizzeria whose official site advertises late delivery to the university area.
cards.evidence_claim: Franco's states that it delivers to Syracuse University and surrounding areas until 3 a.m. daily; its Friday and Saturday menu hours run until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site states delivery to the university and surrounding areas until 3 a.m. daily. Menu hours are Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–12 a.m.; confirm delivery coverage.

cards.title: D.P. Dough on South Clinton Street
cards.subtitle: 315 S Clinton Street, Syracuse
cards.notes: Check the location’s ordering availability before going. The official brand site identifies D.P. Dough as a late-opening calzone business, and the Syracuse listing is identified as late night.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Syracuse calzone destination identified for late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough's official website promotes that it is open late, and the Downtown Committee identifies the 315 S Clinton Street location as open for late-night dining.
cards.access_notes: The official site says “OPEN CRAZY LATE.” The Syracuse location is 315 S Clinton Street; confirm that location’s live pickup or delivery hours before travel.

cards.title: The Pizza Cutters — DeWitt
cards.subtitle: 4461 E Genesee Street, Syracuse
cards.notes: Place an order through the restaurant’s direct ordering page and select the DeWitt location. Its posted schedule includes 1 a.m. closing on Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A DeWitt pizza destination with several published 1 a.m. service nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pizza Cutters’ ordering page lists its DeWitt address and closing at 1 a.m. on Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Pizza Cutters — DeWitt online ordering
cards.access_notes: Published schedule includes Wed 10 a.m.–1 a.m., Fri 10:15 a.m.–1 a.m., and Sat 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m.; hours vary by day. Confirm the live ordering page.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Erie Boulevard East
cards.subtitle: 3179 Erie Blvd East, Syracuse
cards.notes: Use the official locator for this specific restaurant and choose drive-through or delivery as needed. It publishes a 2 a.m. drive-through close every day.
cards.short_summary: An Erie Boulevard East drive-through with a nightly published 2 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 3179 Erie Blvd East and drive-through hours of 7 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted drive-through hours are 7 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier at 10 p.m. Confirm service mode before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Brighton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 962 E Brighton Avenue, Syracuse
cards.notes: Check the official location page before travelling and use the drive-through for the late window. Friday and Saturday drive-through hours are posted through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: An East Brighton Avenue drive-through with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 962 E Brighton Avenue and drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-through hours are until 1 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in closes earlier. Confirm the current service mode.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Thompson Road
cards.subtitle: 6463 Thompson Road, Syracuse
cards.notes: Use the official store page to verify the day before making this east-side run. Its drive-through is posted to 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday and 1 a.m. otherwise.
cards.short_summary: A Thompson Road drive-through with published late-weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists 6463 Thompson Road and drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-through hours are until 1 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in ends earlier. Check the locator for current status.

cards.title: Wendy's on Brewerton Road
cards.subtitle: 3508 Brewerton Road, Syracuse
cards.notes: Consult Wendy’s official restaurant page before heading north of campus. The location’s published schedule includes service until 1 a.m. on Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Brewerton Road fast-food location with a published 1 a.m. Sunday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page for 3508 Brewerton Road lists Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Sunday 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Verify the current day’s lobby, drive-through, pickup, and delivery availability before departure.

warnings: Late-hours listings can change; each card includes the direct source and asks visitors to recheck before travel. D.P. Dough’s official brand page promotes late hours but does not publish Syracuse-specific closing times on that page.
